license_required.quote: A license and a permit are required to practice public accountancy.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the state board of public accountancy established under section 466-4.

moral_character_required.quote: Possesses a history of competence, trustworthiness, and fair dealing

degree_required.value: Baccalaureate or higher degree with at least 150 semester hours of college education
degree_required.quote: an applicant for licensure shall have at least one-hundred-fifty semester hours of college education. Within the one-hundred-fifty semester hours, the applicant shall have: (1) A baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board

accrediting_body.value: College or university acceptable to the board
accrediting_body.quote: a college or university acceptable to the board

required.quote: Each applicant shall present satisfactory evidence in the form of a certified statement from present or former employer(s) that the applicant has met one of the following experience requirements for license

duration.value: 1,500 chargeable hours in audits OR 2 years of professional experience in public accountancy practice
duration.quote: Completion of one thousand five hundred chargeable hours in the performance of audits involving the application of generally accepted accounting principles and auditing standards earned while in public accounting practice; or (2) Completion of two years of professional experience in public accountancy practice

kind.quote: professional experience in public accountancy practice as defined in section 466-3

exams.name: Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination
exams.notes: Board may use the AICPA Uniform CPA Examination and Advisory Grading Service
exams.quote: The board may use the Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination and Advisory Grading Service of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants

interval_years.quote: Licenses shall be effective for a period not exceeding two years and shall be renewable biennially on or before December 31 of every odd-numbered year

required.quote: Completed continuing professional education hours, the content of which shall be specified by the board

available.quote: A person who passed the Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination under the laws of another state may be exempted from taking the examination required pursuant to subsections (a)(5) and (e).

requirements.value: Holds a valid comparable certificate, registration, or license of CPA from another state for at least 10 years and has been in active practice for at least 5 years preceding application; or passed the Uniform CPA Exam under another state's laws.
requirements.quote: Holds, and has continued to hold, a valid comparable certificate, registration, or license of certified public accountant of another state for a period of not less than ten years preceding the date of the person's application under this section, and has been in active practice of public accountancy in one or more states for a period of not less than five years preceding the date of the application.

regulatory_model.quote: A license and a permit are required to practice public accountancy.

title_protection.quote: no person shall assume or use the title or designation "certified public accountant" or the abbreviation "CPA" or any other title, designation, words, letters, sign, card, or device likely to be confused with "certified public accountant" or "CPA" or tending to indicate that the person is a certified public accountant, unless the person holds a current license of certified public accountant issued under this chapter and a current permit to practice issued under this chapter

scope_protection.quote: Continued practice in public accountancy without renewing or restoring a license and permit shall constitute unlicensed activity.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a license or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a license or permit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action taken by another state where the license is canceled, revoked, suspended, denied, or refused renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action taken by another state where the license is canceled, revoked, suspended, denied, or refused renewal

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain compliance with requirements for issuance or renewal of a license or permit, or to report changes to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure, on the part of a holder of a license or a permit to maintain compliance with the requirements for issuance of a license or a permit, or renewal of a license or permit, or to report changes to the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or suspension of the right to practice before any state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation or suspension of the right to practice before any state or federal agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, deceit, fraud, or gross negligence in the practice of public accountancy or in the filing or failure to file income tax returns
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, deceit, fraud, or gross negligence in the practice of public accountancy or in the filing or failure to file a licensee's or firm's own income tax returns

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this chapter or of any rule adopted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision of this chapter or of any rule adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of professional conduct established by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision of professional conduct established by the board under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any crime involving dishonesty or fraud under the laws of the United States, this State, or any other state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any crime an element of which is dishonesty or fraud, under the laws of the United States, of this State, or of any other state if the act involved would have constituted a crime under the laws of this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a license or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a license or permit issued under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct reflecting adversely upon the licensee's or permit holder's fitness to engage in the practice of public accountancy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct reflecting adversely upon the licensee's or permit holder's fitness to engage in the practice of public accountancy.

definition_quote.value: The performance or the offering to perform, by a person or firm holding itself out to the public as a licensee, for a client or potential client of one or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, including the issuance of reports on financial statements, or of one or more kinds of management advisory or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of public accountancy" means the performance or the offering to perform, by a person or firm holding itself out to the public as a licensee, for a client or potential client of one or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, including the issuance of reports on financial statements, or of one or more kinds of management advisory or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters.

value: issuance of reports on financial statements
furnishing of advice on tax matters
methods_authorized.quote: services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, including the issuance of reports on financial statements, or of one or more kinds of management advisory or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters

value: Audit or other engagement in accordance with AICPA statements on auditing standards
Compilation or review of financial statements in accordance with AICPA statements on standards for accounting and review services
Examination of prospective financial information in accordance with AICPA statements on standards for attestation engagements
Engagement in accordance with Government Auditing Standards (Yellow Book) issued by the U.S. GAO
Engagement in accordance with PCAOB standards
attest_services_types.quote: "Attest" means providing the following financial statement services: (1) Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the statements on auditing standards of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants; (2) Any compilation or review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the statements on standards for accounting and review services of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants; (3) Any examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the statements on standards for attestation engagements of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants; (4) Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the government auditing standards, also known as the Yellow Book, issued by the United States Government Accountability Office; and (5) Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board.

compilation_services_authorized.quote: Any compilation or review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the statements on standards for accounting and review services of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants

education_semester_hours_required.quote: an applicant for licensure shall have at least one-hundred-fifty semester hours of college education

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: All firms shall obtain a permit to practice.

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: In the case of a renewal, undergone and provided proof of having undergone the peer review process pursuant to part II.

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: Every firm, including the Hawaii offices and Hawaii engagements of foreign or multistate firms, that is required to obtain a firm permit to practice pursuant to section 466-7 shall undergo a peer review every three years.

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: Neither the proceedings nor the records of any peer review process shall be subject to discovery.

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers, and memoranda made by the licensee, partner, shareholder, officer, director, or employee incidental to, or in the course of rendering services to a client in the practice of public accountancy, except reports submitted by the licensee to the client and except for records that are part of the client's records, shall be and remain the property of the licensee in the absence of an express agreement between the licensee and the client to the contrary.

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: holds a valid comparable certificate, registration, or license or degree from a foreign country determined by the board to be a recognized qualification for the practice of public accountancy in such other country

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by this chapter shall be sufficient to justify a penalty, injunction, restraining order, or conviction, respectively, without evidence of a general course of conduct.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: All firms shall obtain a permit to practice. The board may issue or renew a permit to actively engage in the practice of public accountancy to any firm which submits a completed application and demonstrates qualifications as prescribed by the board.

accounting_practitioner_tier.quote: "Public accountant" means the designation given to a person licensed under section 466-6, or the law of any other state or foreign country.

hawaii_attest_work_supplement_required.quote: A firm shall include, with the peer review compliance reporting form, the contemporaneous Hawaii supplement to the peer review report pursuant to section 466-36, if: (1) A peer review report from an approved sponsoring organization does not include the selection of a Hawaii office or Hawaii attest engagement
